title: When Better Turns Do Not Make Better Agents: Diagnosing the Gap Between Next-Turn Metrics and Workflow Success
abstract: arXiv:2609.21187v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent models are frequently evaluated one decision at a time, where the model predicts the next action based on the gold interaction history, which is scored against a reference. We investigate whether improvement under this protocol is predictive of improved autonomous workflow execution. We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. translated_title: 当更好的单轮表现并不能造就更好的智能体：诊断下一轮指标与工作流成功之间的差距
translated_abstract: 智能体模型通常被逐个决策进行评估，即模型基于黄金交互历史预测下一个动作，并对照参考答案进行评分。我们研究这种评估协议下的改进是否能够预测自主工作流执行能力的提升。我们在多轮客服工作流上研究了监督微调（SFT）前后的Qwen3模型（4B和14B参数）以及Gemma 3模型（4B和12B参数）。我们发现SFT持续提升了文本轮次成功率，并且在黄金历史评估下，每个模型的总体下一轮成功率均有所提高。然而，这些改进并不能迁移到自主工作流执行中。与工具相关的增益在不同指标和模型之间也存在差异。四个SFT模型在整体工作流评估下均未取得成功，严格的轨迹完成最多仅达到10.4%的工作流成功率。我们的结果表明，下一轮评估并不是（可靠的预测指标）……
tldr: 尽管监督微调能提升智能体模型在下一轮预测评估中的表现，但这些改进无法迁移到自主工作流执行中，表明下一轮评估指标并不能可靠地预测智能体的实际工作流成功。
en_tdlr: Although SFT consistently improves next-turn evaluation metrics for agent models, these gains fail to transfer to autonomous workflow execution, showing that next-turn metrics are not reliable predictors of workflow success.
